AMENDMENTS TO LB959
Introduced by Committee
1. Strike the original sections and insert the following new sections:
Section 1. Section 71-1908, Revised Statutes Supplement, 2025, is amended to read:
71-1908 (1) Sections 71-1908 to 71-1923.03 and section 2 of this act shall be known and may be cited as the Child Care Licensing Act.
Sec. 2. (1) [body omitted] For purposes of this section, temporary nonresidential child care program means a program in which child care is provided (a) for no more than twelve consecutive hours.
Sec. 3. Original section 71-1908, Revised Statutes Supplement, 2025, is repealed.
